title: The composition of the cycle families associated to coherent sheaves is the family associated to the tensor product

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-construction-coherent (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2839-2851

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The tensor product is a quasi-coherent finite type module; at each point of the base its fibre decomposes as the tensor of the fibres by right exactness, the fibre of F is flat over the fibre of Y as a base change of a flat module, and the fibre of the composition is therefore the cycle associated to the tensor fibre by the action-coherent lemma, which is exactly the fibre of the claimed family (source lines 2853-2866)

core_obligations: Show alpha circ beta = [F tensor f^*G / X / S]_{r+e} under the flatness hypothesis (proof lines 2853-2866). First observe F tensor_{O_X} f^*G is quasi-coherent of finite type (proof lines 2854-2855). At s in S: (F tensor f^*G)_s = F_s tensor_{O_{X_s}} f_s^* G_s by right exactness of tensor products (proof lines 2856-2860); F_s is flat over Y_s as a base change of a flat module (proof lines 2861-2862); hence the fibre equality (alpha circ beta)_s = [(F tensor f^*G)_s]_{r+e} follows from lemma-action-coherent (tag 0H69) (proof lines 2863-2865), and the fibre-wise identification gives the asserted equality of families.
proof_roadmap: Legitimize the tensor product as a quasi-coherent finite type module (proof lines 2854-2855).
Fibre decomposition of the tensor by right exactness and flatness of the fibre of F (proof lines 2856-2862).
Fibre of the composition computed by the action-coherent lemma, closing the fibre-wise equality (proof lines 2863-2865).
